description: Search Brazilian listed companies in the CVM annual-statements data by name (every word must appear; accents ignored), returning cnpj, name, CVM code and the fiscal years available. Use it to find the cnpj to pass to br_financials or br_financial_series. A query matching nothing returns found:false with data_as_of, never an empty list.

name.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "vale", "banco do brasil".

name: br_financials_search
